name: The Heart of Our Lagoon
source:
A girl lives in a secluded village deep in a lush forest. An encounter with a mermaid will change her forever.

A game about love and how it changes you, blood, pus, and all.  

[From [url=https://velomony.itch.io/the-heart-of-our-lagoon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩住在茂密森林深处的一个僻静的村庄里。与美人鱼的邂逅将永远改变她。

一款关于爱以及它如何改变你、血液、脓液等等的游戏。

[来自[url=https://velomony.itch.io/the-heart-of-our-lagoon]itch.io[/url]]
